assessment: Finish the required labs in each module: they are checked automatically and explained when something is missing.
Pass each module quiz (70% or more). Short tests inside the lessons give instant feedback.
Complete the case study and the final assessment.

faq.q: Does the platform build or run the projects for me?
faq.a: No. The labs check your designs, calculations and writing. You build and test the code in your own tools on a test network.

faq.q: Are these suitable for real use?
faq.a: No. They are learning projects, not audited and not suitable for real value, real elections or legal records.
They can, if you finish them, test them, document their limits honestly and present your judgement as well as your code.

activities.title: Plan the vesting schedule
activities.objective: Calculate the monthly release of a multi-person vesting plan and check how much insiders hold.
activities.scenario: Three groups receive tokens over different periods. The total supply is 100,000,000. (A teaching model.)
steps: In D2 work out the monthly release for the first group: tokens divided by months. Fill down to D4.
In B6 add up the tokens granted.
In B7 add up the monthly releases.
In B8 find the longest schedule in months.
In B9 work out the percentage of the total supply granted (B10 holds the supply).
In B11 show Too much to insiders if B9 is above 10, otherwise Reasonable.

checks.label: D2 is the monthly release
D4 is the monthly release
B6 is the total granted
checks.hint: =SUM(B2:B4)

checks.label: B7 is the monthly total
checks.hint: =SUM(D2:D4)

checks.label: B8 is the longest schedule
checks.hint: =MAX(C2:C4)

checks.label: B9 is the share of supply
B11 is the verdict
checks.hint: =IF(B9>10,"Too much to insiders","Reasonable")

activities.title: Count the votes and check validity
activities.objective: Compute turnout, the winner and whether the result meets the rules.
activities.scenario: A society election has 500 registered voters. The rules: at least 50% turnout; a clear majority means the winner has more than half of the votes cast. (A teaching model.)
steps: In B7 add up the votes cast.
In B8 work out the turnout as a percentage of eligible voters.
In B9 find the winner's votes.
In B10 work out the winner's share of the votes cast.
In B11 show Invalid: no quorum if turnout is below 50, otherwise Valid: clear majority if the winner has more than half the votes cast, otherwise Valid: plurality only.

checks.label: B7 is the votes cast
checks.hint: =SUM(B3:B5)

checks.label: B8 is the turnout
B9 is the winner's votes
checks.hint: =MAX(B3:B5)

checks.label: B10 is the winner's share
B11 is the result
checks.hint: =IF(B8<50,"Invalid: no quorum",IF(B9>B7/2,"Valid: clear majority","Valid: plurality only"))
checks.explain: Check quorum first, then the majority.
